29577-mayflower-flor-de-mayo-a-tale-of-t.title: _A Tale Of The Valencian Seashore_
29577-mayflower-flor-de-mayo-a-tale-of-t.creator: Unknown
29577-mayflower-flor-de-mayo-a-tale-of-t.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Great was the alarm along shore. In the eyes of those poor people, familiar with all the tragedies of the sea, wind from that quarter always meant one of those storms that bring sorrow and mourning to the homes of fishermen. In dismay, their skirts whipping in the blow, the women ran back and forth along the water's edge, wailing and praying to all the saints they trusted.

arxiv-1810-13181.title: WikiConv: A Corpus of the Complete Conversational History of a Large Online Collaborative Community
arxiv-1810-13181.creator: Yiqing Hua, Cristian Danescu-Niculescu-Mizil, Dario Taraborelli, Nithum Thain, Jeffery Sorensen, Lucas Dixon
arxiv-1810-13181.description: Abstract We present a corpus that encompasses the complete history of conversations between contributors to Wikipedia, one of the largest online collaborative communities. By recording the intermediate states of conversations—including not only comments and replies, but also their modifications, deletions and restorations—this data offers an unprecedented view of online conversation.

arxiv-2012-01682.title: Construction of varieties of low codimension with applications to moduli spaces of varieties of general type
arxiv-2012-01682.creator: Purnaprajna Bangere, Francisco Javier Gallego, Jayan Mukherjee, Debaditya Raychaudhury
arxiv-2012-01682.description: Abstract . In this article we develop a new way of systematically constructing infinitely many families of smooth subvarieties X X of any given dimension m m , m ≥ 3 m\geq 3 , and any given codimension in ℙ N \mathbb{P}^{N} , embedded by complete subcanonical linear series, and, in particular, in the range of Hartshorne’s conjecture.

arxiv-2104-07213.title: attentive max feature map and joint training for acoustic scene classification
arxiv-2104-07213.creator: Hye-jin Shim, Jee-weon Jung, Ju-ho Kim, Ha-Jin Yu
arxiv-2104-07213.description: Abstract Various attention mechanisms are being widely applied to acoustic scene classification. However, we empirically found that the attention mechanism can excessively discard potentially valuable information, despite improving performance. We propose the attentive max feature map that combines two effective techniques, attention and a max feature map, to further elaborate the attention mechanism and mitigate the above-mentioned phenomenon.

arxiv-2105-07735.title: The drip lines of kaonic nuclei
arxiv-2105-07735.creator: J. Guo, D. H. Chen, Xian-Rong Zhou, H.-J. Schulze, Q. B. Chen
arxiv-2105-07735.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by J. Guo, D. H. Chen, Xian-Rong Zhou, H.-J. Schulze, Q. B. Chen. The effects of an additional K − K^{-} meson on the neutron and proton drip lines are investigated within Skyrme-Hartree-Fock approach combined with a Skyrme-type kaon-nucleon interaction. While an extension of the proton drip line is observed due to the strongly attractive K − ​ p K^{-}p interaction, contrasting effects (extension and reduction) on the neutron drip line of Be, O, and Ne isotopes are found.

arxiv-2110-04578.title: Tom G. Mackay
arxiv-2110-04578.description: Abstract Characterization of golden vaterite by the extended Maxwell Garnett formalism Abstract The homogenization of vaterite impregnated with gold nanoparticles was accomplished using the extended Maxwell Garnett formalism. The extended formalism takes into account the intrinsic anisotropy of vaterite as well as the size, shape, and orientation of the nanoparticles. Size-dependent permittivity was used for the gold nanoparticles.

arxiv-2305-15402.title: On the connection between Lenz’s law and relativity
arxiv-2305-15402.creator: Thales B. S. F. Rodrigues & B. F. Rizzuti
arxiv-2305-15402.description: Abstract In this work, we demonstrate explicitly the unified nature of electric and magnetic fields, from the principles of special relativity and Lorentz transformations of the electromagnetic field tensor. Using an operational approach we construct the tensor and its corresponding transformation law, based on the principle of relativity.

arxiv-2306-12790.title: DiffWA: Diffusion Models for Watermark Attack
arxiv-2306-12790.creator: Xinyu Li
arxiv-2306-12790.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xinyu Li. With the rapid development of deep neural networks(DNNs), many robust blind watermarking algorithms and frameworks have been proposed and achieved good results. At present, the watermark attack algorithm can not compete with the watermark addition algorithm. And many watermark attack algorithms only care about interfering with the normal extraction of the watermark, and the watermark attack will cause great visual loss to the image.

arxiv-2407-17812.title: Partially rigid motions in the n n -body problem
arxiv-2407-17812.creator: Richard Moeckel
arxiv-2407-17812.description: Abstract . A solution of the n n -body problem in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} is a relative equilibrium if all of the mutual distance between the bodies are constant. In other words, the bodies undergo a rigid motion. Here we investigate the possibility of partially rigid motions, where some but not all of the distances are constant.

arxiv-2412-15742.title: Differential cross-section measurements of D ± D^{\pm} and D s ± D_{s}^{\pm} meson production in proton–proton collisions at s = 13 TeV \sqrt{s}=$13\text{\,}\mathrm{T}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}$ with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2412-15742.description: Abstract The production of D ± D^{\pm} and D s ± D_{s}^{\pm} charmed mesons is measured using the D ± / D s ± → ϕ ⁡ ( μ ​ μ ) ​ π ± D^{\pm}/D_{s}^{\pm}\to\phi(\mu\mu)\pi^{\pm} decay channel with 137 fb -1 of s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV proton–proton collision data collected with the ATLAS detector at the Large Hadron

arxiv-2506-17214.title: Regularized Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation in Highly Adaptive Lasso Implied Working Models
arxiv-2506-17214.creator: Division of Biostatistics, University of California, Berkeley, Oklahoma State University
arxiv-2506-17214.description: Abstract We address the challenge of performing Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation (TMLE) after an initial Highly Adaptive Lasso (HAL) fit. Existing approaches that utilize the data-adaptive working model selected by HAL—such as the relaxed HAL update—can be simple and versatile but may become computationally unstable when the HAL basis expansions introduce collinearity.

arxiv-2507-22866.title: All-polarisation beamsplitters for interferometer applications
arxiv-2507-22866.creator: S.L. Kranzhoff 1,2 , Z. Van Ranst 1,2 , J. De Bolle 3 , S. Coessens 3,5 , S.L. Danilishin 1,2 , C. Detavernier 3 , P.F. Smet 4 , A.P. Spencer 6 , J. Steinlechner 1,2 , S. Steinlechner 1,2 , M. Vardaro 1,2 , S. Hild 1,2
arxiv-2507-22866.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by S.L. Kranzhoff 1,2 , Z. Van Ranst 1,2 , J. De Bolle 3 , S. Coessens 3,5 , S.L. Danilishin 1,2 , C. Detavernier 3 , P.F. Smet 4 , A.P. Spencer 6 , J. Steinlechner 1,2 , S. Steinlechner 1,2 , M. Vardaro 1,2 , S. Hild 1,2. Optical beamsplitters with similar properties for orthogonal, linear polarisation modes are required for realising polarisation-based speedmeter schemes to reduce back-action noise in gravitational-wave interferometers.

arxiv-2508-14705.title: Learning in Repeated Multi-Objective Stackelberg Games with Payoff Manipulation
arxiv-2508-14705.creator: Phurinut Srisawad, Juergen Branke, Long Tran-Thanh
arxiv-2508-14705.description: Abstract We study payoff manipulation in repeated multi-objective Stackelberg games, where a leader may strategically influence a follower’s deterministic best response, e.g., by offering a share of their own payoff. We assume that the follower’s utility function, representing preferences over multiple objectives, is unknown but linear, and its weight parameter must be inferred through interaction.

arxiv-2510-02503.title: A Bilevel Optimization Framework for Adversarial Control of Gas Pipeline Operations
arxiv-2510-02503.creator: Tejaswini Sanjay Katale, Lu Gao, Yunpeng Zhang, Alaa Senouci
arxiv-2510-02503.description: Abstract Cyberattacks on pipeline operational technology systems pose growing risks to energy infrastructure. This study develops a physics-informed simulation and optimization framework for analyzing cyber–physical threats in petroleum pipeline networks. The model integrates networked hydraulic dynamics, SCADA-based state estimation, model predictive control (MPC), and a bi-level formulation for stealthy false-data injection (FDI) attacks.

pmc-10519076.title: Identifying different patterns of emotion dysregulation in adult ADHD
pmc-10519076.creator: Emilie Martz, Luisa Weiner, Sébastien Weibel
pmc-10519076.description: BackgroundEmotion dysregulation (ED) is a core intrinsic feature of adult presenting Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD). However, the clinical expressions of ED are diverse and several questionnaires have been used to measure ED in adults with ADHD. Thus, to date, the characteristics of ED in adult ADHD remain poorly defined.

pmc-10544913.title: Integration of the metabolome and transcriptome reveals the molecular mechanism of drought tolerance in Plumeria rubra
pmc-10544913.creator: Rong Sun, Shan Liu, Jinglei Gao, Lihua Zhao
pmc-10544913.description: Plumeria rubra L. cv. Acutifolia is an ornamental tree that displays a good drought-tolerance level. However, the molecular mechanisms of P. rubra adaptation to drought stress remains unclear. Here, drought-simulating pot experiments were conducted to explore drought stress response mechanism of P. rubra. Transcriptome analysis revealed 10,967 differentially expressed genes (DEGs), 6,498 of which were increased and 4,469 decreased.

pmc-11615168.title: Identification and validation of cigarette smoking-related genes in predicting prostate cancer development through bioinformatic analysis and experiments
pmc-11615168.creator: Duocheng Qian, Xin’an Wang, Tengfei Lv, Dujian Li, Xi Chen
pmc-11615168.description: The morbidity and mortality rates of prostate cancer (PCa) are high among elderly men worldwide. Several factors, such as heredity, obesity, and environment are associated with the occurrence of PCa. Cigarette smoking, which is also an important factor in the development of PCa, can lead to genetic alterations and consequently promote PCa development.

pmc-12384711.title: The Dark Side of Vascular Aging: Noncoding Ribonucleic Acids in Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction
pmc-12384711.creator: Jianning Chen, Xiao Xiao, Charles Zhou, Yajing Zhang, James Rhee, Haobo Li, Guo-Chang Fan, Ao Shi, Chen Gao
pmc-12384711.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) represents a growing global public health challenge, now accounting for approximately half of all heart failure cases and often linked to a systemic pathophysiological process in older adults with multiple comorbidities. Despite increasing recognition of the vascular contributions to HFpEF, the precise molecular mechanisms, particularly the role of noncoding Ribonucleic Acids (ncRNAs) in mediating vascular aging and subsequent cardiac dysfunction, remain incompletely understood.

pmc-12467678.title: Off-Season Reproductive Performance of Tsurcana Ewes Under Five Estrous Induction Protocols with Different Hormonal Profiles
pmc-12467678.creator: Nicolae Adrian Giurginca, Marioara Nicoleta Caraba, Gabi Dumitrescu, Ioan Pet, Elena Pet, Adrian Sinitean, Delia Hutanu, Ion Valeriu Caraba, Claudio Gustavo Ustavo Barbeito, Fabiano José Ferreira De Sant’Ana, Wanxi Yang
pmc-12467678.description: Simple SummaryTsurcana sheep are a traditional Romanian breed, but their numbers are declining because small family farms that raise them for both milk and meat often struggle to remain profitable. Supporting the survival of this breed requires improving their reproduction, especially outside the natural breeding season when lambs are needed for income and flock renewal.

pmc-12495187.title: Emerging West Nile Virus Threats in Temperate Climates: A Call for Integrated Public Health Strategies
pmc-12495187.creator: Sejuti Reza, Syed Masudur Rahman Dewan
pmc-12495187.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). le in the emergence of various mosquito-borne diseases (MBDs), posing substantial challenges to public health. Consequently, vector-borne diseases such as chikungunya, dengue, and Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever (CCHF) remain a significant concern for public health. This underscores the necessity for additional research and the development of adaptive public health strategies to confront these evolving challenges, particularly in relation to the persistent threat of WNV.

pmc-12609430.title: RETRACTED: Duloxetine, an SNRI, Targets pSTAT3 Signaling: In-Silico, RNA-Seq and In-Vitro Evidence for a Pleiotropic Mechanism of Pain Relief
pmc-12609430.creator: Sayed Aliul Hasan Abdi, Gohar Azhar, Xiaomin Zhang, Jeanne Y. Wei
pmc-12609430.description: Chronic pain is a serious health issue, often irrationally managed by conventional analgesics. Duloxetine, a serotonin–norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI), also effective in neuropathic and musculoskeletal pain, but the molecular mechanism of its analgesic action is still unclear. Here, we examined whether Duloxetine exerts pleiotropic effects by directly targeting phosphorylated STAT3 (pSTAT3), a key regulator of neuroinflammation and pain sensitization.

pmc-12699211.title: The genome sequence of the Common Moorhen, Gallinula chloropus (Linnaeus, 1758) (Gruiformes: Rallidae)
pmc-12699211.creator: Toby D. Humby, Michelle F. O’Brien, Rosa Lopez Colom, Natural History Museum Genome Acquisition Lab, Wellcome Sanger Institute Tree of Life Management, Samples and Laboratory team, Wellcome Sanger Institute Scientific Operations: Sequencing Operations, Wellcome Sanger Institute Tree of Life Core Inf
pmc-12699211.description: We present a genome assembly from an individual male Gallinula chloropus (Common Moorhen; Chordata; Aves; Gruiformes; Rallidae). The assembly contains two haplotypes with total lengths of 1 282.39 megabases and 1 208.56 megabases. Most of haplotype 1 (92.66%) is scaffolded into 38 chromosomal pseudomolecules, including the Z sex chromosome. Haplotype 2 was assembled to scaffold level.

pmc-13269914.creator: Dorian de la Fuente, Julia Karbach, Ulrike Basten, Julia A Glombiewski, Tina In-Albon, Tanja Lischetzke, Christina Mema, Rebecca A Rammensee, Marcel C Schmitt, Tanja Könen

pmc-13290921.title: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists: Their Therapeutic Potential in Cystic Fibrosis
pmc-13290921.creator: Theodoros Panou, Evanthia Gouveri, Djordje S. Popovic, Nikolaos Papanas
pmc-13290921.description: Cystic fibrosis (CF) is a monogenic disorder leading to pulmonary disease, pancreatic insufficiency and cystic fibrosis-related diabetes (CFRD). Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) are now being investigated in people with cystic fibrosis (pwCF) and CFRD. To date, their therapeutic potential has been almost exclusively studied in case reports or case series.

pmc-13478266.title: Determinants of fungal infection and hospital readmission risk in interstitial pneumonia with autoimmune features: associations with vitamin D and pirfenidone
pmc-13478266.creator: Gaodi Yuan, Xiufang Xie, Min Tang, Xiaoli Zheng, Xiongyan Luo, Anji Xiong
pmc-13478266.description: BackgroundFungal infections significantly compromise the prognosis of patients with interstitial pneumonia with autoimmune features (IPAF). However, the specific immune-related risk factors and their impact on clinical stability remain poorly defined. This study aimed to identify independent predictors for fungal infection and early readmission to optimize risk stratification.

pmc-13581632.title: Intrauterine device migration into the bladder with resultant bladder stone formation: a case report
pmc-13581632.creator: Meilian Chen, Hongmei Xiao, Fei Lai, Yingxue Bai, Yixue Zhou, Xuelian Tan, Limei Wu, Haixia Jiang
pmc-13581632.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the possible aetiology, clinical characteristics, diagnostic and therapeutic approaches, and prognosis of intrauterine device (IUD) migration into the bladder.Case reportA 39-year-old woman presented with recurrent symptoms of urinary urgency and dysuria. Computed tomography scans (CT) revealed that one arm of the IUD had migrated into the bladder, causing bladder stones.
